name: Wandering Parts
body:
Although commonly disjointed, some marionettes attain a level of cohesion that allows them to control wayward limbs.

Prerequisite(s): Constitution 16, marionette

Benefit(s): For a number rounds per day equal to your Constitution score, you can treat dismembered limbs as dancing weapons. Dismembered limbs modified in this fashion use the damage profile of a club. In addition, a marionette that has lost his head is no longer blind as long as there is line of sight between his head and the rest of his body.
